name: BO-4 Missing evidence — request info, never deny
description: Goods not received with merchant contact never recorded: request_info, never a rejection. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-4. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-4 (goods_not_received) has NO merchant-contact evidence recorded and NO expected delivery date. That is MISSING evidence. The task must decide request_info with required_info naming the specific missing items (merchant contact and/or expected delivery date) and queue outreach to collect it. Fail ONLY if: (a) the outcome is auto_reject (denying for missing evidence) or auto_approve; (b) required_info does not name the specific missing item; (c) case-notify is never called.
